sections.footer: Switches the wall terminal to its CCTV tab.
Wall screens only react within 3.6 m, like Doom 3. The phone always does.
Render targets only render while a screen is showing them.

cells.text: Every screen here is an EntityGUI: a Doom 3-style GUI surface that emits textured quads in its own virtual screen space and is placed on its entity through the surface's texture axes.
Like Doom 3, a GUI draws on its surface with a depth bias and no stencil: it never z-fights, stays hidden behind things in front of it, and its quads are depth-tested against their own screen.
The whole facility, including these pages, is described by data in js/scenario.js.
